column1: # E045 hand labels — a reader's own labelling of the 189 harvested issues
# Written by reading the title and the requester's own first paragraph of every
# row in raw/issues.jsonl, with no access to the rule classifier's output. One
# reader (the session's agent), no second reader: single-reader limitation is
# declared in the README, not averaged away.
# Columns, tab-separated, indexed by the position of the row in the sorted order
# used by read.py (repo asc, number asc):
#   idx  is_git_staging_need  requester  diff_access  operation  wants  basis
# is_git_staging_need  1 when the issue is about choosing *which lines/hunks*
#                      of a working-tree change reach the index; 0 otherwise.
# requester            gui-human | script | agent   (who runs the operation)
# diff_access          explicit | gui-implied | none  (evidence that the
#                      requester can see a diff; "none" means the issue says
#                      nothing about it, NOT that the requester lacks one)
# operation            what the issue asks to be able to do
# wants                one line: the interface the requester says is missing
